newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BOLAND ATHLETICS TO COMBINE INTO SINGLE BODY.
newsitem.headline: BOLAND ATHLETICS TO COMBINE INTO SINGLE BODY.

text.p: The warring factions in the long-running feud over who runs Boland athletics are to combine in a temporary administration.

Athletics South Africa (ASA) announced in Johannesburg on Thursday that they were ordering the move after accepting the recommendations of the Arendse Commission which was set up in January to resolve the matter.

ASA previosuly recognised two chairman of Boland athletics but now the two factions -- formed around ASA track and field chairman Charles Beukes and his opponent Conwal du Plessis of the powerful Stellenbosch AC -- have been told to nominate six people each to serve on an interim management committee.

The committee will be chaired by Boland Cricket Union president Henry Paulse, a regional member of the National Sports Council, until elections under a revised constitution are held at the end of October, 1998.
ASA also lifted the suspension on all Boland administrators, officials and coaches in January when the factions refused to accept the mediation of advocate Norman Arendse.
The Boland Unity track meeting -- scheduled for Monday -- has been put back to April 14.
